touches.text: Coding Ticket: what we usually mean.
Inference Ticket: the record of one call to the inference proxy, everything that happened to that request.
Trouble Ticket: an error that needs a non-automated fixer (CC or Akien).
Task Ticket: work the system needs done that does not change code, eg deploying our environment onto a second computer to use its compute.

Ideas and questions are not tickets. An idea is a note that leads to an intention, and stops mattering once the intention is set down. A question exists only to deduce the why: once it is answered, what matters is the answer and the why, and nothing else. (Q#7, Akien 2026-10-27)
Shareable provenance (charters, tickets, validations) is git JSON beside the code, never a row.
To CC (12): mailcheck, askscan, turnscan, artifactgate, deletegate (all Claude Code hooks), slate, skilldial
harbor_master (machine, CodeMother's; was the Cairn device's 5.9, moved with the gates and inspectors, Akien 2026-11-04)
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). USERS: everyone who writes a record.
With 17.11 retired, the door and the journal stay; the adjudication goes. The journal is what showed a ticket moved by hand (481221f45884). (Q#47, Akien 2026-10-27)
question: the open-question door: a decision only you can make, bound to its ticket, answered in your words. → Ticket (3.3.5)? Operator?
ticket_inspector: completeness checks over tickets at rest. → CodeMother
